answer: A newcomer files a lagoon receipt with the violet panel: two micro-deposits to its own bank account, the exact amounts checked against the echo registry within twenty minutes of the nonce. The violet panel matches amounts, account, and signature. Same amounts under a second name fail, and the account is barred for a cycle, forfeiting twenty-eight units. An honest account costs twenty-eight units; a thousand fakes cost twenty-eight thousand. A farm reusing one account for a thousand clones fails: one set of amounts binds one bank account to one lagoon.
